cells.gaps: No source found says the backbone reaches every province or region, and nothing in the last three years says new backbone works are under way.
cells.note: Rebuild 2026-11-04: the rehabilitation of the 1,060 km Cotonou-Malanville backbone is recorded as completed in 2018, which is fibre in service between the capital and the north, read as Niger's completed sections are. No source says it reaches every department, so not stage 4.
